title: CLCON/43/2015 of Shri Guru Nanak Shiksha Samiti AND ANOTHER Vs Smt Sushma Singh AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No. 43 of 2015
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
There is no representation for the petitioners.
Mr. J.S. Bisht, Brief Holder for the State of
Uttarakhand.
Writ Petition No. 1580 (M/S) of 2009 filed by the
petitioners was disposed of vide order dated 26.06.2014.
Operative portion of the said order is extracted below:-
"Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that defects as
pointed out in the letter dated 18th August, 2008, shall be cured
within three days. On curing of the defects, no adverse action is
required to be taken against the petitioners on the ground of non
submission of fresh scheme of administration.
Order accordingly."
In this contempt petition, it is alleged that the opposite
parties have willfully disobeyed the order of this Court.
A response affidavit has been filed by Ms. Sushma
Singh, Additional Director of Education. In para nos. 6 & 7 of
the said affidavit, it has been stated that the defects as pointed
out by the Office of Additional Director of Education vide
letter dated 18.08.2008 were not cured by the petitioners and
instead, petitioners submitted a fresh scheme of
administration. It has further been stated in the response
affidavit that since petitioners failed to cure the defects within
the time frame fixed by this Court in its order dated
26.06.2014; therefore, an Authorized Controller was
appointed.
Petitioners subsequently challenged appointment of
Authorized Controller by filing Writ Petition No. 624 (M/S)
of 2015 and this Court vide judgment dated 19.03.2015
quashed the order appointing Authorized Controller.
In view of the aforesaid facts and reasons, this Court is
of the considered opinion that this is not a case of willful
disobedience of the order passed by this Court.
Accordingly, the contempt petition fails and is
dismissed.
Contempt notices issued against opposite parties are
hereby discharged.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Navin 03.01.2020
